title: The Zipper on a Small Coat
youtube_title: The Zipper on a Small Coat | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: A small useful favor can be louder than a big speech.
summary: At a market lane of baskets, jars, and flower pots, a zipper on a small coat that had caught is awkward for one person. Idris notices Grandma Nia struggling and takes a useful half of the job without asking to be praised.
